title: Rambam Hospital: Teacher injured in school trip in serious, stable condition; 3 teens hospitalized
summary:
Rambam Hospital in Haifa provided an update on four people injured in Monday's tragedy during a school trip at Ramim Ridge.

Two teenagers who sustained minor injuries are hospitalized in the pediatric surgery department. A third teenager, who was moderately injured by shrapnel to the neck, is under observation in the pediatric intensive care unit. He is fully conscious and in stable condition.

The teacher injured in the incident underwent surgery overnight and remains hospitalized in the general intensive care unit in serious but stable condition.
